Live Theme Park Queue Times

Theme Parks Wiki has been used to collect the live queue data of the Efteling.

The choice was made for this medium since its well-documented.

The general API-explanations can be found at;
https://themeparks.wiki/api

The interactive documentation of the API can be found at;
https://api.themeparks.wiki/docs/v1/

Specifications on endpoints and rate limits can be found at;
https://themeparks.wiki/api/http

Specifications on OpenAPI / Swagger can be found at;
https://themeparks.wiki/api/openapi
